corrections_applied.issue: Absence of a tamper-evident, append-only observation ledger for runtime observations and empirical proof.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Defined the tamper-evident observation ledger specification at runs/<run_nonce>/observations.jsonl with SHA-256 hash chaining, required fields (sequence, obs_id, timestamp, operation, target/locator, current version/ref, SHA-256 content hash, excerpt, status, parent_hash, record_hash), ledger integrity rules, and explicit anti-tamper blocking criteria.
corrections_applied.program_change: Implemented ObservationLedger class in send-to-gemini.js providing append-only persistence to runs/<run_nonce>/observations.jsonl, SHA-256 chaining, genesis hash invariant, and pre-evaluation integrity verification with tamper detection.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Added observation_ledger configuration pointing to filename observations.jsonl under the run container.
corrections_applied.rationale: Prevents fabricated or retroactively altered empirical evidence by enforcing a cryptographic hash chain for every recorded observation.

corrections_applied.issue: Runtime reads directly touched filesystem and git without mechanical auditing or observation logging, while boundaries on external ChatGPT tool executions were unstated.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Documented the Evidence Gateway architecture and stated the true boundary of the Trusted Computing Base: ChatGPT executions occur externally via GitHub tools and cannot be intercepted by process wrappers, but all runtime inspections of the workspace, git objects, and run containers must pass through the Evidence Gateway and be logged to the ledger.
corrections_applied.program_change: Implemented EvidenceGateway wrapping fs and git interactions, computing canonical content hashes and excerpts, validating paths, and logging every material read/check into the run's ObservationLedger.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Added evidence_gateway configuration settings (hash_algorithm, max_excerpt_bytes, path_rules).
corrections_applied.rationale: Ensures every check performed by the supervisor is mechanically recorded in the append-only ledger without making impossible claims about intercepting external agent processes.

corrections_applied.issue: Lack of an authenticated controller evidence request and receipt mechanism to allow repository-backed observation capture before final step submission.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Specified the controller observation request and receipt protocol, defining execution return requirements and CLI/runtime observation mode (--observe / mode: observe) that yields authenticated receipts containing runtime-generated obs_ids.
corrections_applied.program_change: Implemented runObservationMode and observation request handling in send-to-gemini.js, supporting both CLI invocation (--observe <request_file_or_run>) and trigger-based mode ('observe'), executing requested target inspections through EvidenceGateway and outputting signed observation receipts.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Added observation_requests configuration defining standard request file location and output receipt paths.
corrections_applied.rationale: Allows workflow triggers or agents to request runtime-authenticated observations prior to submitting completion schemas, giving Step 4 verifiable obs_id references.

corrections_applied.issue: Evidence in Step 4 completion claims was vulnerable to fabricated locators and unverified prose claims.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Updated Step 4 execution return schema and evaluation requirements so completed_actions must bind each completion claim to a verified runtime observation_id (obs_id) and matching target_locator/content_hash, prohibiting unverified self-report.
corrections_applied.program_change: Added deterministic binding validation in validateStep and collectGroundTruth, verifying that cited observation_ids exist in the active run ledger, belong to the active run, target the claimed path, reflect VERIFIED status, and match observed hashes. Unbound or mismatched claims generate blocking ground-truth findings.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Configured observation binding requirements under verification_policy.
corrections_applied.rationale: Ensures no completed action can pass supervisory gating on model assertion alone; every completion must mathematically correlate with an authenticated runtime observation.

corrections_applied.issue: Susceptibility to pattern gaming and lack of randomized adversarial verification of live workspace state.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Added Governing Rule for Deterministic Randomized Adversarial Verification: deriving a deterministic PRNG seed from live run invariants (run_nonce, step, attempt, git HEAD), generating at least 16 distinct live-state probe categories, computing ground-truth oracles mechanically, and auditing consistency.
corrections_applied.program_change: Implemented generateAdversarialProbes with 16 probe categories (file exist, non-empty, file hash, line count, git tracked status, git head match, git commit object, git blob object, ledger chain integrity, file size, state schema, message count, store record match, directory entry match, trigger file match, config schema match) seeded by SHA-256(run_nonce + step + attempt + git HEAD). Evaluated oracles via EvidenceGateway and persisted probe audit records.
corrections_applied.rationale: Prevents static hallucination and test-memorization by testing live state unpredictably yet deterministically on every turn.

corrections_applied.issue: Supervisory gate transition allowed Gemini semantic judgment to potentially override or obscure deterministic ground-truth failures.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Codified the Conjunction Gate Invariant in Governing Rules: real PASS is strictly (deterministic live ground truth PASS AND Gemini supervisory PASS). Neither model nor supervisor can waive, reinterpret, or bypass a blocking ground-truth failure. Any other combination is FAIL.
corrections_applied.program_change: Replaced supervisory gate transition calculation with strict code conjunction: const realPass = groundTruth.aggregate_status === 'PASS' && geminiGate.gate_result === 'PASS'; const gateResult = realPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'; Gemini's gate_result is recorded but overridden if ground truth failed.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Explicitly declared conjunction_gate transition invariant in config.json.
corrections_applied.rationale: Guarantees that deterministic code, not LLM judgment, holds absolute veto power over step advancement.

step3_evaluation_artifact.description: Merged Step 3 evaluation heuristic and TSR test suite
